'''Knots in Washington''' is an international conference on [[knot theory]] and its ramifications held twice a year since 1995.  The main organizers are [[Józef Przytycki]], Alexander Shumakovitch, Yongwu Rong and [[Valentina Harizanov]], all of whom are at [[George Washington University]].<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2007/03/18/AR2007031801483_pf.html|newspaper=[[Washington Post]]|title=In the Loop: What Goes Around Comes Around, All Tied Up in Knots|date=March 19, 2007 |first=Paul|last=Richard}}.</ref>

This conference has become an important [[topology|topological]] event in the [[Washington Metropolitan Area]] and regularly attracts well-known topologists from other areas of the US and from other countries.<ref>{{citation|url=https://blogs.gwu.edu/ccas-knotsinwashington/|title=Knots in Washington – Knot theory conference held twice a year at the George Washington University }}</ref> For example, Knots in Washington XVIII, held in May 2004, was the first conference fully devoted to the [[Khovanov homology]], with [[Mikhail Khovanov]] giving a series of talks and leading experts [[Dror Bar-Natan]], Lev Rozansky, [[Oleg Viro]], and [[Ciprian Manolescu]] giving plenary talks.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://at.yorku.ca/cgi-bin/amca/canv-01 |title=Knots in Washington XVIII Abstracts |access-date=2009-08-28 |archive-date=2009-11-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091109174720/http://at.yorku.ca/cgi-bin/amca/canv-01 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Knots in Washington XX was dedicated to the 60th birthday of [[Louis H. Kauffman]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://at.yorku.ca/cgi-bin/amca/capo-01 |title=Knots in Washington XX Abstracts |access-date=2009-08-28 |archive-date=2009-11-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091109104027/http://at.yorku.ca/cgi-bin/amca/capo-01 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Other related conferences include Knots in Poland (1995, 2003),<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://at.yorku.ca/cgi-bin/amca/calg-01 |title=Knots in Poland 2003 |access-date=2009-08-28 |archive-date=2011-06-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110604232403/http://at.yorku.ca/cgi-bin/amca/calg-01 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and Knots in Hellas in 1998, where [[Fields Medal]] winner [[Vaughan Jones]] spoke about his work on [[knot invariant]]s.<ref>[http://www.worldscibooks.com/mathematics/4452.html Knots in Hellas - Proceedings of the International Conference on Knot Theory and Its Ramifications]</ref>

Knots in Washington 50 will take place Dec 6th-8th, 2024 at the George Washington University with updated website: https://blogs.gwu.edu/ccas-knotsinwashington/
